additional_info.subject: RE: ID0458258-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / S2 170003248] Unsuccessful charge DC3 CRM:03056000340
additional_info.body:
No that is not the case. That is the autocharge. The charger cannot reach cable check if the authorization is not accepted.
Please do not just look at one session, no sessions on DC3 have been successful since October 18 and they fail on cable check as showed in the case.

additional_info.subject: ID0458258-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / S2 170003248] Unsuccessful charge DC3 CRM:03042000086
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0458258
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-DK SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / S2 170003248
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
After our analysis and checks, we have found that the problem is related to the dispenser contactor (Q231 and Q232).
However, before proceeding with the replacement, we would like you to take some measurements using the clamp meter on the connection between the main charger (WC231 WC 232).
If everything is fine there, please proceed to measure at the dispenser contactor.
I will send you some screenshots to guide you through the measurement process.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DK SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,

Younes Baroudi
